name: Cessna 188 AgWagon / Ag Truck
summary: Cessna's single-seat, strut-braced low-wing agricultural monoplane of 1966–83, using the tail of the Cessna 180 and a large fibreglass hopper in front of a raised cockpit.

wings: Low wing braced by a strut each side
Straight wing with flaps along the trailing edge
engines: Single Continental flat-six in a deep, blunt cowl
fuselage: Fibreglass hopper ahead of a high single-seat cockpit
Raised cab with a large windshield
tail: Tall, swept Cessna 180-style fin and rudder

tellTales: Low-wing crop sprayer with a strut under each wing
Tall, swept fin of a classic taildragger

confusedWith.howToTell: The Cessna 188 has a deeper, blunter cowl for its larger engine and a tall swept fin; the Pawnee has a slimmer nose and a squarer Piper tail.
The 188 is a small strut-braced low-wing with a flat engine; the Air Tractor is bigger, cantilever and has a radial or turbine engine.
The 188 has struts and a flat engine; the Thrush is a cantilever monoplane with a blunt radial or turbine nose.
The 188 is a low-wing single-seat sprayer; the 180 is a high-wing four-seat taildragger.
